purpose: Adds IS_ERR_OR_NULL checks to fwnode APIs and updates macros so error pointers can be passed safely, avoiding dereference of invalid handles and ensuring proper fallback handling.
Updates the QMP PHY devicetree binding YAML to correct the child node description from per‑lane to per‑PHY, improving documentation accuracy.

The commit introduces infrastructure for Firmware Assisted Memory (FAMS) switching: adds shutdown flag, new DMUB commands, capability fields, helper functions, and integration points across DC core, hardware sequence, resource handling, and FPU calculations.
Adds a CONFIG_UML guard around x86‑specific caching code in ttm_module.c so the driver compiles on User‑Mode Linux, fixing a build‑time error.
Adds const qualification to static arrays of qcom_icc_bcm pointers in the SC8280XP interconnect driver, making them immutable because they are never modified, enhancing safety.
Adds CONFIG_32BIT guards to SBI PMU ecall arguments so that 64‑bit values are correctly split on RV32, fixing wrong argument handling in 32‑bit builds.
The commit replaces direct accesses to perf_cpu_map structures with the official perf_cpu_map API across perf tools, adding loops using the API and improving reference‑count handling.

The patch adds tracepoints for DMA allocation and free paths, refactors the allocation helpers to pass the caller name, introduces wrapper macros that embed __func__, and updates trace event definitions to record the caller. This enables runtime tracing of DMA operations for debugging.

The patch refactors the cs42l42 driver by separating the probe into bus‑specific, common, and register‑initialisation stages, introduces a common_probe helper, an init function, and an init_done flag, and updates remove/suspend handling to avoid register accesses before initialization, preparing the driver for SoundWire support.
Adds a device‑tree node for the QCOM sc7280 Data Capture and Compare (DCC) hardware, defining compatible strings and register address ranges.

The patch replaces direct (void *) casts of const pointers with (void *)(uintptr_t) casts and removes unnecessary casts when passing data to dma_map_single, ensuring proper de‑consting and compilation on stricter systems.
The patch refactors vfio_ap_find_queue to use the AP bus's ap_get_qdev() hash‑table lookup instead of driver_find_device iteration, removing the match function and improving lookup efficiency.
Fixes NFSv4.2 CLONE handling where a zero‑length clone incorrectly set the destination inode size to zero by computing the correct count from the server‑provided size.
Adds a static inline get_snr() function to extract the Signal‑to‑Noise Ratio from the wcn36xx receive descriptor, enabling future use such as implementing mac80211 get_survey().

The patch changes RAID5 stripe handling to use full bio_init/uninit instead of partial initialization and later bio_set_dev/op_attrs and bio_reset, removing pre‑initialization loops and simplifying bio handling.
The patch removes an unnecessary backslash at the end of a line in the spr_cstates[] flags definition, simplifying the code without altering behavior.
Introduces CONFIG_OBJTOOL, replaces CONFIG_STACK_VALIDATION usages, adds HAVE_OBJTOOL config, updates Kconfig selections, Makefile, scripts and packaging to support objtool as an optional feature.
The patch changes descriptor read/write helpers to use __le32 pointers instead of u32, fixing sparse-reported endianness type mismatches and ensuring correct byte order conversion.
The commit corrects a misspelling in the SCSI ChangeLog documentation, changing 'caste' to 'cast' in a comment about format specifiers.

Updates the i.MX fractional‑N GPPLL rate table, changing the mfd field from 0 to 1 for several entries because the hardware specification disallows a zero value, preventing illegal register programming.
Fixes incorrect error code returned by kill_accessing_process() when a page is already hardware-poisoned, preventing duplicate SIGBUS and spurious "Memory error not recovered" messages.
Updates the snvs-lpgpr devicetree binding YAML to list both specific i.MX8M compatible strings and the fallback fsl,imx7d-snvs-lpgpr, correcting the documentation of compatible properties.
The patch removes an unnecessary dev_err call after devm_ioremap_resource, because the helper already logs errors, cleaning up duplicate logging.

Adds mrouter port support to the Sparx5 Ethernet driver, introducing a flag, handling multicast flooding, a switchdev attribute, pgid updates, and clearing logic to enable ports to act as multicast routers.

The commit renames the struct xilinx_pcie_port to xilinx_pcie and updates all related code, comments, and function signatures to follow the <driver>_pcie naming convention, without altering functionality.
The patch removes an unused variable and a dev_vdbg debug print from qmp_combo_init, cleaning up verbose logging and dead code.

The commit replaces the old .txt device‑tree binding for a GPIO IR LED transmitter with a new .yaml schema file and updates MAINTAINERS to reference it, converting the documentation to the DT schema format.

The patch modifies unx_lookup_cred() to allocate the credential structure with kmalloc using rpc_task_gfp_mask(), and only falls back to mempool for async lookups, matching rpc_malloc() behavior and fixing allocation failures.
Adds two new compatible strings (lenovo,thinkpad-x13s and qcom,sc8280xp-crd) to the QCOM device‑tree binding documentation, extending the list of supported sc8280xp devices.
Adds a device‑tree node for the Qualcomm SM8150 Ethernet (ethqos) controller, defining compatible string, registers, clocks, interrupts, power domain, resets, IOMMU, and default disabled status.
Replace magic shift constant 9 with PAGE_SECTORS_SHIFT macro and drop unnecessary cast in read_part_sector, improving readability and maintainability.
The commit updates the DASD driver’s sysfs handling to use the newer default_groups field instead of default_attrs, adding ATTRIBUTE_GROUPS macro and adjusting the kobj_type struct accordingly.

The patch replaces manual read‑modify‑write code for DVO enable/disable with the generic intel_de_rmw() helper and switches to intel_de_posting_read(), improving consistency and safety of register accesses.
Deletes the hisilicon,hi6220-reset devicetree binding file because the related controllers are already documented elsewhere, removing duplicate documentation.
Reverts a prior change that set num_pipe_per_me to 2, restoring it to 1 to stop graphics hangs on Navi 21 with GNOME Wayland.
Adds a wrapper struct to store the __iomem pointer, updates init and mapping functions to use it, and eliminates sparse address‑space conversion warnings.
Adds CRIU support for discovering SVM ranges: new struct fields, info function, and integration in kfd_chardev to report count and size, plus header prototypes.

Adds a new boolean field submission_initialized to intel_guc, uses it to track GuC submission initialization instead of the LRC descriptor pool pointer, and updates init/fini logic accordingly. Improves code clarity and state tracking.
Adds a helper to validate the true 32‑bit offset range for auipc+jalr relocations and replaces the previous signed‑32‑bit check, fixing incorrect range rejection on RISC‑V.
Adds error handling for clk_enable in davinci_mmc resume: stores return value, checks for failure, returns error if clk_enable fails, preventing continuation on error.
Adds missing asterisks in comment blocks of trace_events_hist.c to fix clang "bad line" warnings, a cosmetic comment correction.

The patch enlarges the 'name' buffer in exynos_mct driver from 10 to 11 characters and adds a comment, fixing truncation when timer IDs exceed two digits, ensuring correct printing of mct_tick per CPU.
Fixes a hang after KVM VM migration on PowerPC by initializing the decrementer expiry relative to the guest timebase when TB_OFFSET is set, and removes the previous default initialization.
Adds f2fs_io_flags() to compute I/O flags during bio allocation, replacing earlier direct flag attachment, to keep flags consistent and avoid I/O splitting between fio holders.
The patch replaces a compound page check with PageHead() in compound_range_next(), removing a redundant order test and simplifying the logic.
Removes HAL_DEF_IS_SUPPORT_ANT_DIV handling from GetHalDefVar8188EUsb, adds rtw_antenna_diversity helper, updates callers, and deletes the enum entry, as part of cleaning up the HAL layer.

The patch corrects DSC bits_per_pixel handling in the DPU hardware configuration by removing incorrect fractional‑bit extraction and directly writing the 6.4‑format value, fixing the register calculation.
The commit rewrites the perf test script to use the built‑in thloop workload instead of compiling a custom C program, removing the need for a compiler and simplifying the test.
Adds a guard in hci_cmd_sync_queue to abort command queuing when the device is being unregistered, returning -ENODEV to avoid use‑after‑free crashes.

The patch adds a likely() hint to the XDP_REDIRECT/TX check in ice_clean_rx_irq_zc, restructures the control flow, and moves bookkeeping statements, aiming to help the compiler generate better‑predicted branches and improve performance.
The patch adds an arp_invalidate() helper with a force flag and calls it when broadcast routes are added, clearing stale unicast neighbour entries that caused packet drops.
The commit deletes an unnecessary #include <asm/termios.h> from drivers/tty/n_hdlc.c because linux/tty.h already provides the needed termios definitions, simplifying header usage.
The patch changes brcmstb_reset() from a global to a static function, eliminating a -Wmissing-prototypes compiler warning in the sdhci‑brcmstb driver; it does not modify runtime behavior.

The commit deletes all guest‑PASID related UAPI structures, helper functions and driver callbacks from the IOMMU core and headers, because they are unused and will be replaced by the new iommufd design.
Adds return‑value check for mmc_add_host() in moxart driver, freeing allocated host on error to avoid memory leak and crash.
The patch replaces a 64‑bit modulo operation that required the undefined __umoddi3 helper on i386 with div_u64_rem, fixing a build‑time undefined symbol error for the amdgpu driver.

The patch removes the storage of encryption keys in macsec flow structures, passes the key directly to transformation functions, and deletes related copies and zeroing, preventing key duplication and improving security.
Replaces kmalloc with kvmalloc (and kfree with kvfree) for vhost/vsock packet buffers, preventing allocation failures for large packets (e.g., 32 KB) that caused SFTP over vsock crashes.

The patch removes DP83822_RX_ERR_HF_INT_EN from the interrupt mask in dp83822_config_intr, disabling the RX error high‑frequency interrupt that caused an interrupt flood when the RCSR register filled, because the driver never reads/clears that register.
Adds the compatible string "aries,m100pfsevp" to the RISC-V Microchip devicetree bindings YAML, documenting support for the Aries Embedded M100PFSEVP platform.
Adds runtime DSP path creation and freeing support to the Intel AVS ASoC driver, introducing path.c implementation, path.h API, new fields in avs_dev, and Makefile update to compile the new module.
Adds a conditional to always flush the TLB on Vega20+XGMI GPUs because PTEs can be cached in the texture cache, preventing stale entries from causing stalls.
Adds support for Allwinner H616 USB PHY by defining a new configuration struct with its specific quirks and registering a compatible device tree entry.
Adds support for the IVO M133NW4J-R3 eDP panel by inserting a new entry in the edp_panels array, using an existing timing macro due to missing documentation.
Renames the KVM self‑test evmcs_test to hyperv_evmcs, updates .gitignore and Makefile accordingly, aligning naming with other Hyper‑V tests.
Adds the static qualifier to the of_match tables in arizona I2C and SPI drivers, making them internal after the tables were split and are no longer exported.

Adds infrastructure for KPP template instances, defining struct kpp_instance, free handling, registration helper, and associated kernel-doc helpers, enabling future template‑based key‑agreement algorithms.

The patch reorders IRQ registration in the imx‑rngc driver, moving devm_request_irq after imx_rngc_irq_mask_clear to avoid handling a stale SEED_DONE interrupt that caused premature completion and a kernel crash during boot.

The commit cleans up the QMP PHY devicetree binding YAML by removing redundant description fields, replacing them with boolean true, and tightening array size constraints, resulting in clearer documentation without changing kernel behavior.
Updates ADI ADC device‑tree binding docs to add AD7927, clarify AD7923/AD7924 relationship, deprecate AD7924, and restructure compatible property with oneOf schema.
The commit raises the max_brightness value for the Dream Cheeky HID LED from 31 to 63, correcting the previously too‑low default based on empirical testing.
Adds a default case to mvebu_pcie_hw_rd_conf() that returns all‑ones and PCIBIOS_BAD_REGISTER_NUMBER for unsupported read sizes, mirroring the write path.

Removes the local bit_reverse function in lib/packing.c, replaces its use with the generic bitrev8() from linux/bitrev.h, adds BITREVERSE selection in Kconfig, and updates includes to reduce code duplication.

The patch reorders initialization: it calls local_flush_tlb_all() right after setup_ptwalker() and before page allocation, and moves output_pgtable_bits_defines() into tlb_init(). This prevents stale TLB entries that caused the second kernel of kexec/kdump to fail booting SMP.

The patch adds a per‑fiemap cache for backref sharedness checks, introduces cache structs and helper functions, updates the shared‑extent detection routine to use the cache, allocates the cache in extent_fiemap, and tracks root‑drop generations to keep cache validity.
Updates perf c2c documentation to include the 'N/A' store metric, adding explanatory text and adjusting the report table.

The commit moves the definitions and exports of mach_hwclk, mach_get_rtc_pll, and mach_set_rtc_pll from generic setup files into arch/m68k/kernel/time.c, ensuring they are present only when needed, fixing undefined reference errors during compilation of nommu m68k with CONFIG_RTC_DRV_GENERIC.
Adds a function to free allocated enclosure structures and calls it during driver unload and controller reset, eliminating a memory‑leak issue.

Fixes race and double‑free issues in hugetlb vma lock handling during VMA splitting and range unmapping by allocating a fresh lock for duplicated VMAs, adjusting lock acquisition/release, and making the lock a condition for PMD sharing.

Adds support for switching to a different time namespace during a vfork+exec sequence by detecting vfork completion, invoking timens_on_fork after exec, and relaxing clone flag checks, without introducing a new clone flag.

The commit removes the per‑CPU dying list from conntrack, deletes related structures and functions, switches to the per‑net dying list, adjusts unconfirmed list handling, and sets IPS_CONFIRMED earlier to avoid double unlinking.
The commit fixes a duplicated word 'is' in a comment of ab8500_fg.c, changing 'is is' to 'is' in the function documentation.
Adds firmware‑derived I2C timing support to the DesignWare PCI driver by invoking i2c_parse_fw_timings and removing hard‑coded bus frequency.
The commit adds handling for the X86_FEATURE_XENPV CPU feature in disabled-features.h, defining a macro based on CONFIG_XEN_PV and incorporating it into the disabled feature mask.

The commit adds a new CPU feature flag X86_FEATURE_RETHUNK, updates disabled‑features, and implements code to optionally rewrite compiler‑generated return‑thunk jumps to RET, with corresponding sections and module handling, allowing systems affected by the previous return‑thunk patch to avoid it.
Adds AVDD and MICVDD supply properties to the rt5682s devicetree binding YAML, documenting required regulators and updating examples.

The patch removes redundant resetting of architecture‑specific control arrays in set_mba_sc() and instead resets mbps_val[] within reset_all_ctrls(), simplifying the code path for MBA software controller handling.

The patch renames the vkms_composer struct to vkms_frame_info throughout the vkms driver, updating all field accesses and related variable names. It also adjusts comments and a warning check, but does not alter functionality.
The patch updates fbcon's sysfs show functions to use sysfs_emit instead of snprintf, changing two return statements to the newer helper for sysfs output.

The patch removes assignments to udc->dev.driver in the USB gadget UDC core, keeping the driver pointer NULL and eliminating a race that caused a use‑after‑free in dev_uevent, directly fixing the syzbot‑reported bug.
Adds missing iounmap() in zorro7xx_remove_one() to release a mapping allocated during probe, fixing a resource leak.
The patch renames the .set_fmt_new callback in the jz4740 I2S driver back to the standard .set_fmt name, reflecting the core’s migration to the new direct‑clock specification.

The patch restructures the OnDisassoc function in the r8188eu driver, moving the non‑AP handling path out of the main if‑statement, adding an early return and reorganizing variable declarations to simplify the logic without altering behavior.

Adds intel_async_flip_check_uapi to perform early async‑flip validation, introduces basic checks (CRTC active, modeset required, plane enabled), renames existing async check and integrates it into the atomic check flow.
The patch drops kernel-doc comments from static functions in drm_edid.c, replacing them with plain C comments while preserving the explanatory text.

The patch updates the spear keyboard driver to replace the deprecated SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS macro with DEFINE_SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS, uses pm_sleep_ptr, and removes __maybe_unused from suspend/resume functions, eliminating compiler warnings.
Adds rdma_get_udp_sport inline helper to compute UDP source port from a GRH flow label or, if absent, from local/remote QP numbers, exposing a new API in ib_verbs.h.

Adds support for the on‑board RT711 SDCA audio codec on MeteorLake (MTL) platforms by extending the DMI quirk table, defining ACPI endpoint/ADR structures, and registering a new machine entry with the appropriate topology file.

The patch replaces the firmware‑aware MCR wait function with a non‑fw version that acquires and releases uncore->lock internally, updates callers, adds lockdep assertion, and fixes a race where the caller previously omitted the lock.
Adds support for a new AMD PMC controller version by defining a new CPU ID (AMD_CPU_ID_CB) and handling it throughout the driver (PCI/ACPI IDs, register reads, debugfs, OS hint, probing).

The patch updates the r8188eu driver to use the generic ieee80211_get_DA helper instead of the driver‑specific get_da, adding a header cast and adjusting the comparison. This aligns the driver with the common mac80211 API.
Adds a new compatible string for the Elan eth3915n touchscreen controller in the devicetree binding documentation, enabling kernel to recognize this hardware variant.
Replace scnprintf with sysfs_emit in mcdi_logging_show to follow sysfs guidelines, improving correctness of sysfs output handling.

Adds support for Intel LBR format V7 (Goldmont plus/Tremont) by adding capability flags to x86_pmu, implementing intel_pmu_lbr_init() to set them, refactoring LBR handling to use these flags, and invoking the init from core.
The patch merges the LED_871x struct into led_priv, removing the nested struct and updating all code to use the unified led_priv structure for LED handling in the r8188eu driver.
The patch changes the read of the capability word from a 64‑bit nn_readq to a 32‑bit nn_readl because the address is not qword aligned, avoiding exceptions on some architectures.

Ensures consistency between NFT_SET_CONCAT flag and field_count in nf_tables set creation: if multiple fields are specified without the flag, or the flag is set without field_count, the commit returns -EINVAL, adding validation.
Updates Makefile to set PATCHLEVEL to 2, adds '-rc1' EXTRAVERSION, and changes the NAME string, preparing the 6.2 release candidate.
The patch restores x2AVIC support by allowing APIC MSR writes for registers other than ICR in x2APIC mode, removing a warning and adjusting the write path in kvm_apic_write_nodecode.

The patch corrects the length check in tipc_nl_compat_name_table_dump_header by casting sizeof(struct tipc_name_table_query) to int, ensuring proper handling when TLV_GET_DATA_LEN returns a negative value, fixing a KMSAN uninitialized‑value bug reported by syzbot.
Adds compatible strings for the Altera Stratix10 SoC Development Kit in two device tree files, allowing the kernel to recognize and support this board.
Adds avdd-0v9-supply and avdd-1v8-supply properties to the HDMI node and renames regulator nodes to match the hardware schematic, eliminating a kernel warning about missing supplies.
Renames the IIO test Kconfig entry and corresponding Makefile variable to IIO_FORMAT_KUNIT_TEST, aligning with the CONFIG_<name>_KUNIT_TEST naming convention required by KUnit.
The patch updates a KVM arm64 self‑test to use the proper KVM_GUESTDBG_ENABLE constant instead of the unrelated SINGLE_STEP_DISABLE enum, clarifying intent without altering runtime behavior.

The commit replaces the legacy .txt device‑tree binding for Qualcomm GSBI with a new .yaml DT schema file, deleting the old text file and adding the schema that defines properties, examples, and validation rules.

The patch splits protection handling into separate read and configure steps, moves configuration to the end of device discovery, removes a duplicated revalidate call, and simplifies logging, thereby cleaning up the DIF/DIX workflow.
Adds audio support for the RZ/G2UL SMARC EVK by defining SSI1 pinmux, linking CPU DAI to SSI1, and conditionally enabling the SSI1 node in the device tree.

Removes the forced IRQF_TRIGGER_RISING flag in the ath10k SNOC driver, allowing the interrupt type to be set via Device Tree, which resolves bind failures on hardware where the interrupt is level high.
The patch removes the erroneous __user qualifier from the buffer argument of proc_dointvec_minmax_sysadmin, restoring the correct function signature after it was moved to printk/sysctl.c.

Adds full GPIO interrupt support to the Microchip PCI1xxxx driver: includes interrupt header, defines new register offsets, implements irq_ack, irq_mask/unmask, irq_set_type, an IRQ handler, registers an irq_chip, and requests the IRQ in the driver setup.
Removes an unused work_struct field from struct mlx5e_async_ctx in the kTLS transmit code, cleaning up dead code.

The patch fixes a congestion‑management bug in RxRPC where a zero cwnd persisted across calls, causing stalls. It replaces cwnd with ssthresh, adds idle‑reset logic based on RTT, tracks last transmission time, updates structures and trace events, and adjusts related code paths.

The commit relocates three inline helper functions (btrfs_root_readonly, btrfs_root_dead, btrfs_root_id) from accessors.h to ctree.h, where the btrfs_root structure is defined, to keep related code together and simplify syncing with btrfs-progs.
The commit adds a case for IP_VERSION(13,0,9) in amdgpu_discovery_set_ip_blocks, assigning the SMUIO function table, thereby enabling support for the new SMUIO hardware block.
The patch raises the max average DRAM bandwidth usage percentage for DCN315 from 30% to 60% to resolve DML validation failures when multiple HDR displays are connected, aligning it with DCN31 values.

The patch changes the 4 GB boundary check to use the DMA address of memory pools instead of the virtual address, updating the helper function signature and all call sites accordingly, fixing a condition that could cause out‑of‑range DMA operations.
Adds a dt-binding property 'us-euro-gpios' to describe a GPIO used for selecting CTIA/OMTP headset mode on the wcd938x codec.
The patch reorders error‑cleanup in mlx5e_fs_init(): it now frees VLAN structures before kvfree’ing the flow‑steering object, preventing a use‑after‑free that could occur on initialization failure.

The patch restores proper peer cleanup for station disconnect on QCA6390/WCN6855 by conditionally skipping only the WMI_PEER_DELETE command, fixing a use‑after‑free caused by missing peer->sta nulling.
The commit deletes the unused rxrpc_kernel_get_reply_time function, its prototype, and documentation because the call issue time is now used instead of reply time.
The commit updates Luca Ceresoli’s maintainer email address from the personal domain to the Bootlin address in three devicetree binding YAML files, reflecting the preferred contact information.
Fixes probe() error handling in mpfs musb driver by returning proper negative error codes on allocation and phy registration failures.

The commit moves registration of netdevice and switchdev notifiers from each device probe to module initialization, preventing duplicate notifier registration when multiple ADIN1110/2111 devices are present, thus eliminating probe warnings and failures.
The patch removes the inefficient jfs_writepage function and replaces it with the generic buffer_migrate_folio helper, updating the address_space_operations struct accordingly.

Adds support for the new SCD_QUEUE_CONFIG_CMD introduced in newer firmware, extending the queue allocation API to use station masks and new flags, updates driver structures, config handling, and tx queue allocation logic to work with both old and new command versions, and ensures queues are removed before stations.
Adds a new helper function virt_get_pte_hva to obtain the host virtual address of a PTE for a given guest virtual address, and refactors addr_arch_gva2gpa to use this function.
The commit removes deprecated perf buffer APIs, deletes alias and versioned wrapper functions, simplifies option structs, and updates the libbpf symbol map, cleaning up the perf buffer interface.

The patch adds USB audio quirk entries for Fiero SC-01 devices with firmware v1.0.0 (48 kHz and 96 kHz), mirroring the existing v1.1.0 quirks, and registers corresponding flags, thereby enabling proper operation of these devices.
The patch deletes the io_run_task_work() call at the start of io_uring_enter, postponing task work until after submissions to improve batching and overall performance.
Reorganizes OMAP3 clock nodes in DTS files, adding a ti,clksel parent node and clock-output-names to match updated clock driver bindings and eliminate device‑tree warnings.
Corrects a misspelled word in a comment in fs/ocfs2/quota_global.c, changing "exlusive" to "exclusive".

The patch rewrites try_to_free_swap and its helper to operate on struct folio instead of struct page, using folio helpers and removing compound_head calls, reducing kernel text size by about 74 bytes.
Changes cfg80211_auth_request.key_idx from unsigned u8 to signed s8, allowing -1 sentinel for NULL key and removing static checker warnings.
Adds a boolean reset flag to WED TX/RX ring setup functions and updates all call sites, preparing the driver for future reset handling of the Wireless Ethernet Dispatcher.
Adds CAP_SYS_ADMIN checks to NVMe ioctl commands (reset, subsystem reset, rescan) so only privileged users can invoke them, matching existing passthrough restrictions.

Adds CRIU restore support for AMD GPU driver by passing queue private data to queue creation functions and allowing allocation of SDMA queues with a specific sdma_id, restoring the same IDs used during checkpoint.
The patch removes the HW_VAR_AC_PARAM_VI enum and its handling in SetHwReg8188EU, replacing the indirect SetHwReg call with a direct rtw_write32 in the WMMOnAssocRsp path, cleaning up unused code.
Replaces snprintf with sysfs_emit/sysfs_emit_at in MHI sysfs attribute show functions to satisfy static analysis warnings.
Reorganizes OMAP3 clock definitions in the device tree by adding a ti,clksel node that groups related clocks, adds clock-output-names, and removes duplicate mux nodes to silence DTS warnings.

The commit introduces a new Intel Meteor Lake pinctrl/GPIO driver. It adds a Kconfig option, updates the Makefile, and provides a full source file defining pins, pad groups, communities, ACPI matching, and driver registration.

The commit extracts QCS404 peripheral authentication service device‑tree bindings from the generic ADSP bindings file into a dedicated qcom,qcs404-pas.yaml file, removing those entries from qcom,adsp.yaml and adding the new schema file.
Adds example 'clocks' and 'clock-names' entries to the SDM845 camera clock binding documentation, enabling the driver to recognize a bi-tcxo clock from the device tree.

The patch changes the dsa_switch struct's num_ports field from size_t to unsigned int, reducing struct size by eliminating padding, and updates the dev_err format string in dsa2.c to match the new type.
Removes redundant chip type comments from the FTDI USB serial driver, cleaning up struct field comment and case label comments, improving readability without altering functionality.

The patch refactors address‑validation code in the RXE driver, introducing a generic chk_attr helper used by both QP and AH, adds wrapper functions, and replaces pr_warn calls with rxe_dbg_* debugging macros, updating callers accordingly.

The patch modifies amdgpu_ras_feature_enable to allocate and send RAS feature commands only when the block is GFX, removing a generic inline helper and adding explicit block checks, thus preventing unnecessary operations for other blocks.
Removes Jukka Rissanen from the MAINTAINERS entry for 6LOWPAN, reflecting that he no longer maintains that subsystem.
Initializes the 'next' pointer to NULL in find_first_clear_extent_bit to eliminate an uninitialized variable compile error, ensuring the function builds correctly.
Adds visible memory tracking to the i915 TTM buddy allocator: new fields, allocation checks, debug prints, init parameter, and a helper function exposing visible size.
Implements a common mechanism for CXL.mem drivers to enumerate ancestor CXL switch ports, track endpoint interest, and manage port lifecycle, adding new structs and functions and updating ACPI code.
Removes the deprecated function fscrypt_set_test_dummy_encryption and its prototype because all callers now use the newer APIs, cleaning up dead code in the fscrypt subsystem.

The patch refactors the Hisilicon VFIO PCI driver to use the new generic device lifecycle helpers. It moves migration‑specific initialization into a dedicated init callback, removes now‑unused vfio_pci_core_{un}init_device functions, and updates probe/remove paths accordingly.

The patch simplifies submit_stripe_bio by removing the orig_bio and clone arguments, deriving orig_bio from bioc and deciding cloning based on dev_nr, thus cleaning up the function signature and logic.

The patch replaces explicit zero entries for reserved bits in pinmux register tables with compact shorthand entries using negative widths, merging consecutive reserved fields, which reduces the driver’s compiled size.

The patch reorders the if/else chain in read_clock_frequency to test newer GRAPHICS_VER values first, adds comments, and adjusts frequency calculations for gen11 and other generations, aligning the driver with a ‘last version first’ style.
Updates the packed vmcb_control_area struct in KVM self‑test headers, adding SEV‑ES related fields and reserved space to match recent kernel changes.
The patch deletes the buddy prefetch helper and related prefetch logic from free_pcppages_bulk, arguing that prefetching under the zone lock adds overhead with little benefit.
The commit adds a new self‑test program to verify that enabling branch stack does not crash on any platform, updating the Makefile and providing the test source.

Adds error handling to ftpm_mod_init(): captures driver_register return, checks for failure, unregisters platform driver on error, and returns the error code instead of returning driver_register directly.
Adds a static serial_rs485 structure with flags and delays for the MAX310X UART driver and assigns it to the port's rs485_supported field in the probe function, exposing supported RS485 features.

The patch refactors MMU V1 hop address calculations by introducing a generic get_hop_pte_addr that uses hop_masks and hop_shifts arrays, removing per‑hop helper functions. Mapping and unmapping now loop over hops, simplifying allocation and cleanup. Added MMU_V1_MAX_HOPS macro and updated function pointers.
The commit changes a dev_warn call to dev_dbg for -ENODEV cases in thermal zone registration, treating the condition as expected and reducing log verbosity.
The commit replaces a hard‑coded 1000 ms timeout in the USB control message used to read EDID with the standard USB_CTRL_GET_TIMEOUT constant (5 seconds) for consistency across the driver.
Adds a check in gfxhub_v3_0_3_init_system_aperture_regs to return early on SR‑IOV virtual functions, avoiding programming system aperture registers that are no longer accessible.
Removes the unused vgpu->released atomic field and its associated sanity‑check code from the i915 GVT driver, as the VFIO core now handles vGPU lifecycle.
Removes the unused arch_has_empty_bitmaps flag from resctrl structures and updates validation to use min_cbm_bits, simplifying the code.
Adds amdgpu_ras_query_poison_mode function to encapsulate poison‑mode detection, removes duplicated code from amdgpu_ras_init, and invokes the new helper, simplifying the driver code.
The commit changes the type of ata_port::fastdrain_cnt from unsigned long to unsigned int because it is only ever assigned from 32‑bit values, reducing the field size accordingly.

Updates VFS and related code to use the folio abstraction for is_partially_uptodate, changing prototypes, implementations, and documentation from page‑based to folio‑based signatures and adjusting callers accordingly.

The commit deletes two '# CONFIG_SURFACE_PLATFORMS is not set' lines from RISC‑V defconfig files to keep the CONFIG_SURFACE_PLATFORMS entries sorted like savedefconfig; it introduces no functional change.

The patch corrects the selection of the microengine (me) and engine selector for the MAP_QUEUES packet in gfx11 KIQ mapping, using the ring type to set proper values instead of the previous incorrect logic.

The patch updates traceon/traceoff trigger handlers to use the per‑instance tracer (trace_event_file) when a trigger is attached to an instance, instead of the global tracing state, ensuring enable/disable actions affect only that instance.

The patch adds a static inline helper mcp251xfd_is_fd_mode() that returns true when the device is in listen‑only or CAN‑FD mode, and replaces direct bit‑mask checks with calls to this function in FIFO and ring initialization code.

The patch removes the helper that performed a series of mount/umount operations when switching network namespaces in BPF selftests, replacing it with a direct setns call and closing the fd, simplifying open_netns and close_netns.

The patch replaces direct access to plane->state with drm_atomic_get_new_plane_state() and updates the function signatures to use the proper atomic state argument, aligning the driver with the recommended DRM API.

The patch replaces the per‑vcpu boolean sysregs_loaded_on_cpu with a generic state flag (SYSREGS_ON_CPU) using the existing flag infrastructure, removing the struct field and updating load/store and read/write helpers to use the new flag.
Adds a forward declaration for struct folio in cacheflush.h to eliminate compilation warnings for users of the header.
The patch relaxes the VHT MCS index check in mt7921 driver from >9 to >11, allowing frames with MCS10-11 that the hardware can handle, preventing them from being erroneously dropped.
Adds a syscon reference and a clk-phase-sd-hs property to SDMMC nodes in several device tree files, enabling software to configure the CIU clock phase via the system manager.
Adds a free(params) call before exiting osnoise_top, fixing a memory leak where parsed command line arguments were not released.

Adds support for SubVP DRR handling on DCN32/321 by introducing a firmware‑assisted manual trigger command, updates DMUB service, modifies lock logic to avoid VSYNC lock for DRR flips, and integrates the new functions into the timing generator.
Renames the reference‑counting helpers in the RXE driver: rxe_add_ref → rxe_get and rxe_drop_ref → rxe_put, updating all call sites and macro definitions for clearer, conventional naming.
Adds a call to swap_free(entry) when arch_unmap_one fails, correcting a missing cleanup after a prior swap_duplicate, thus fixing a memory‑leak/incorrect state bug in the rmap unmap path.

Adds a library that interfaces the Cirrus Logic CS_DSP firmware controls with the HDA driver, exposing them as ALSA controls. Introduces a Kconfig option, Makefile entry, new source files, and updates MAINTAINERS.
The commit updates the kernel Makefile EXTRAVERSION from -rc5 to -rc6, marking the sixth release candidate of Linux 5.19.
The patch modifies tdp_mmu_set_spte_atomic to capture the value returned by cmpxchg and assign it to iter->old_spte, removing duplicated manual SPTE reads in callers and updating related comments.

The patch adds clock handling to the hisi I2C driver: includes clk.h, stores a clk pointer, tries to obtain a clock via devm_clk_get_optional_enabled, and falls back to reading the clk_rate property, then uses the rate for controller configuration.
Adds a variable to capture the end of a GAP hole and logs its size (as physical address bits) in the kernel message, enhancing visibility of UV GAM range information.
Initializes the vqs_list_lock spinlock in vdev_info_init, fixing a hang in virtio_test caused by the lock being uninitialized.

Implements a new hot‑page selection algorithm for NUMA memory tiering using hint‑page‑fault latency, adds hot‑threshold sysctl, reuses struct page bits, and integrates rate‑limit logic, while also fixing a bug when disabling tiering.
Adds a Chinese translation of the devicetree changesets documentation and updates the Chinese index to include the new file.
The patch updates LSE atomic compare‑exchange macros to use size‑matched casts (u##sz) instead of unsigned long *, removing -Warray-bounds warnings while keeping the generated binary unchanged.

The commit moves the extract‑cert program from scripts/ to certs/, updates certs/Makefile to build it on demand, adjusts .gitignore entries, removes stale references, and modifies build flags. It reorganizes build infrastructure without altering functionality.

The patch updates stmmac_change_mtu to permit MTU changes while the interface is up by reallocating DMA descriptors, restarting the device, and resetting the receive mode, removing the previous -EBUSY restriction.

The patch relocates the pmu_ops pointer from kvm_x86_ops to kvm_x86_init_ops, marks the pmu_ops structures as __initdata, and updates all references, reducing memory usage and making the ops immutable after init to avoid post‑init modification bugs.
The commit removes an outdated reference to max77693.txt from the MAINTAINERS file that was re‑added by a merge conflict, correcting the documentation after the file was converted to YAML.
Updates the SM8350 pinctrl devicetree binding to require 'function' only for GPIO pins, allowing non‑GPIO pins like SD‑card to omit it.
Adds a new selftest case for BPF BTF decl_tag handling in function prototype return types, expecting a load error and triggering a WARN_ON_ONCE.

The patch modifies the RTC self‑test suite to handle the case where the RTC device node is absent. It removes the mandatory open assertion and adds a check in each test to skip execution when open fails with ENOENT, preventing spurious test failures.
The commit updates fbtft_init_display() to use fbtft_par_dbg_hex for printing init sequence values, correctly handling s16 type instead of the previous generic hex dump.

Adds a completion to synchronize VF allocation, waits for host association before proceeding, and adds MAC‑based fallback matching to resolve a race where VF registration can occur before the host's VF association message.

The patch adds an mm pointer argument to svm_range_handle_list_op, acquires the mm reference before processing deferred ranges, moves mmap write lock handling inside the loop, and balances mmget/mmput to keep the mm_struct alive, fixing a use‑after‑free bug in the SVM deferred list work.

The patch introduces optional prepare_streaming and unprepare_streaming callbacks in videobuf2, updates the core to invoke them during VIDIOC_STREAMON and cleanup, adds counters and debug prints, and extends the vb2_ops and vb2_queue structures accordingly.

The patch modifies qla_edif.c to clear the previous authentication session and optionally reset the link when the authentication app starts, preventing remote devices from logging in during a stale session, thus reducing N2N login thrashing.
Adds a reference‑count guard around snd_rawmidi_drain_output and synchronises it on close to avoid races with buffer resize, fixing a crash/incorrect behavior during long drains.

The patch moves several extent_io_tree helper functions (find_first_clear_extent_bit, lock_extent_bits, etc.) from fs/btrfs/extent_io.c to fs/btrfs/extent-io-tree.c, adds a needed include, and deletes the original definitions to shrink the core file.
Adds a __vcpu_run() inline helper that wraps the KVM_RUN ioctl and updates several self‑test files to use it, removing duplicated ioctl calls and related variables.
Adds new MCU command and driver routines to enable background radar (DFS) detection on a dedicated chain, exposing a set_radar_background operation for zero‑wait CAC support.
Adds a second reg entry to RK3399 VOP nodes in the device tree, defining the gamma LUT memory region to enable gamma control support.
Adds a guard in kvm_pv_clock_pairing to reject the KVM_HC_CLOCK_PAIRING hypercall when the vCPU runs with tsc_always_catchup, preventing an infinite loop in pvclock_read_retry.
Adds a missing @server parameter description to the kernel-doc comment of smb311_update_preauth_hash, removing a warning from make W=1.
Adds six new Qualcomm SoC identifier macros to the dt-bindings header, enabling device tree support for QDU1000, QRU1000 and related variants.

The patch corrects the error‑check after calling platform_get_irq() in ipaq‑micro driver: it now treats any negative return as failure instead of checking for zero, preventing false‑negative handling and returning -EINVAL.
The patch replaces the three-step thread creation (kthread_create_on_node, kthread_bind, wake_up_process) with the single helper kthread_run_on_cpu, updating the boost task creation in rcutorture.c.

Refactors lpfc driver ELS handling to use generic get/set routines and unify SLI‑3/SLI‑4 code paths, introducing local variables and conditional handling for SLI‑4, removing indirect structure accesses.

The commit separates VBT data into per‑panel structures, moving panel‑specific parsing to connector probing and updating many drivers to use connector->panel.vbt instead of the global dev_priv->vbt, adding panel VBT defaults and cleanup functions.

The patch deletes an unused assignment to the variable 'bytes' in snd_echo_midi_output_write, leaving only 'sent = 0'. This removes a dead store that triggered a clang static‑analysis warning, without altering runtime behavior.
Adds support for Intel Agilex SoC in the DWC2 USB driver by defining platform‑specific parameters and registering the compatible device ID.

The patch removes the _bh variants of spinlock, rwlock, and seqlock calls throughout the rxrpc subsystem, replacing them with the regular (non‑BH) versions. The change reflects that RCU callbacks no longer acquire these locks and packet processing now runs in a regular kernel thread, so disabling bottom‑half handling is unnecessary.

The patch updates the ti-dac5571 I2C driver to use the newer .probe_new() callback, removing the id argument and retrieving the device ID via i2c_client_get_device_id, adapting to kernel driver API changes.
The patch deletes many unused struct members, tables, reset/clock handling, and DP‑related code from the Qualcomm QMP UFS PHY driver, streamlining the driver and eliminating dead code paths.
Adds a GCC_SDCC_BCR reset using reset_control in the sdhci-msm driver, called during probe to clear previous power states and avoid observed reset timeout failures.

The patch corrects the K210 device‑tree timer nodes by splitting them, fixing register ranges and interrupt assignments to match the hardware spec, eliminating dtbs_check warnings about non‑standard interrupt configurations.
Adds "qcom,msm8974-cci" compatible string and updates description in the i2c-qcom-cci devicetree binding documentation.
The patch loads the actual VA bits (vabits_actual) during CPU resume on arm64 when VA_BITS > 48, fixing boot failures on 52‑bit enabled builds.
The patch adds proper error handling in ssi_init(): it stores the result of platform_driver_register, unregisters ssi_pdriver on failure, and returns the error code, fixing a resource‑leak bug.
The patch modifies bio_copy_data_iter to map both source and destination bio_vecs, copy the appropriate bytes, and unmap them, restoring correct handling of destination offsets required by bcache.
Implements optional reset‑GPIO handling for onboard USB hub driver, adding pdata for reset timing, acquiring GPIO in probe, toggling it on power on/off, and extending device tree match data.
The patch cleans up include directives in the 8250_dw serial driver: it removes unused of_irq.h and of_platform.h and adds the missing mod_devicetable.h, correcting the header list.
The patch replaces the signed left‑shift (1 << i) with the BIT(i) macro (1UL << i) in __mdiobus_register, eliminating undefined signed shift and fixing the UBSAN shift‑out‑of‑bounds warning.
The patch makes detailed_timing structures passed to EDID parsing callbacks const, updating typedefs and all related functions to use const pointers, improving const‑correctness.
The patch updates the xhci driver to also block U2 link power management when Intel tier policy disallows LPM, adding early policy checks and removing previous U2‑specific bypass.
The patch deletes an unused local variable 'ret' in rtw_wx_get_essid and returns 0 directly, simplifying the function.
The patch adjusts the condition for creating an ext4 lazy‑init request, so read‑only ext4 filesystems no longer start the ext4lazyinit thread, avoiding unnecessary bitmap prefetch work.
The commit updates STM32 device‑tree pinctrl node names, replacing "pin-controller@…" with the preferred "pinctrl@…" to silence node‑name warnings introduced by pinctrl.yaml.
The commit deletes the former maintainer entry from the NTC thermistor devicetree binding documentation because the email address is no longer reachable.
The commit replaces kernel-doc's custom usage() calls with Pod::Usage's pod2usage, adding the module import and updating error handling for missing or unknown arguments.

The patch extends the TPS68470 clock driver to handle multiple consumers, introduces a flexible array in platform data, and populates it from ACPI consumer devices, enabling several sensors to share the same clock.
Adds a new SocketCAN line‑discipline driver (can327) for ELM327 OBD‑II adapters, includes documentation, Kconfig, Makefile updates, and maintainer entry.

The commit adds a missing space in the heading row of the ext4 blockmap documentation table, realigning cells so the reStructuredText table parses correctly and the Sphinx 'Malformed table' warning disappears.

The commit updates the MMIO thermal driver to use the new generic OF registration API, changing the temperature callback signature, ops struct type, and registration call to the newer devm_thermal_of_zone_register.
Updates the MT8365 mutex module array to reference the newly added DDP_COMPONENT_DITHER0 enum index, keeping the code consistent with earlier enum changes; no functional behavior is altered.

The patch updates blk_crypto sysfs registration functions to accept a struct gendisk pointer instead of a request_queue, modifies the internal header, implementation, and callers, and adds inline stubs, preparing the block layer for future sysfs handling changes.

The patch removes an unnecessary spinlock around a potentially sleeping kernfs function, adds a lock‑free helper for default hierarchy cgroup lookup, and adjusts related callers. It also adds assertions and BUG_ON checks, improving correctness and code clarity.
Adds rockchip,enable-strobe-pulldown to the emmc_phy node in the NanoPi4 device tree, re‑enabling the internal strobe pull‑down that was disabled and caused HS400 I/O errors.
Adds support for DSD audio formats (U8, U16_LE, U32_LE) to the Freescale SAI ASoC driver by extending the format bitmask in fsl_sai.h.
Adds proper error handling in sun8i_a83t_mipi_csi2_resources_setup() and probe() by storing error codes, jumping to cleanup, and releasing clock_mod, fixing resource‑leak issues.
The commit renames GPIO macro definitions by adding a f7188x_ prefix and updates all references, keeping the driver’s macro namespace clean without changing functionality.
Adds a best‑effort call to try_to_generate_entropy() during /dev/urandom reads when the CRNG is not ready, making the RNG opportunistically initialized on platforms with fast cycle counters.
The patch reorders initialization in rtc-cmos driver so that cmos_wake_setup is called after cmos_do_probe, preventing a NULL pointer dereference in rtc_handler during boot.
The commit corrects a typo in the ioat driver module parameter description, changing "idel" to "idle"; it only modifies a string literal and does not affect code execution.

The patch updates mm/vmscan.c to replace references to "pages" with "folios" in comments, enums, function names and related code, aligning terminology with the folio memory model while leaving the functional logic unchanged.

The commit updates the AD5380 I2C driver to use the newer .probe_new() callback, removing the explicit i2c_device_id argument and fetching it via i2c_client_get_device_id, aligning with current kernel driver API.
Renames iscsi_conn_queue_work to iscsi_conn_queue_xmit across the iSCSI driver, updating its definition, calls, export symbol and header to reflect that it only queues transmissions.

The patch modifies __io_account_mem to use atomic_long_try_cmpxchg instead of a compare‑and‑swap loop, eliminating an extra read/comparison and simplifying the code; behavior remains unchanged, only performance and clarity improve.

The patch removes obsolete validation and fwspec‑freeing code from various IOMMU driver release_device implementations, because release_device is now invoked only after successful probe via per‑device ops, making those checks redundant.
Corrects a misspelled word in comments across three driver files, improving documentation clarity.
Adds '#reset-cells' property definitions to the DT binding YAML files for MT8192 and MT8195 sys-clock, documenting that the reset cell count is 1.
Adds support for Intel 5 Series/3400 PCI device ID 0x3b57 by inserting it into the azx_ids table with appropriate driver data, enabling HDMI/DP audio via i915.

The patch corrects how the self‑test parses the return value of system() calls, using WIFEXITED/WEXITSTATUS to propagate child errors instead of returning the raw waitpid integer, which was always zero due to exit() masking.

The commit adds support for the TX push mode to the ethtool ring‑parameter API: updates documentation, kernel structures, netlink enums, policies, and get/set handling, enabling users to query and configure TX push via ethtool -G/g.
Removes an unnecessary 'return;' from the void function vt1708_set_pinconfig_connect in the VIA HDA driver, cleaning up code as the return has no effect.
The patch makes rcuscale buildable without enabling RCU Tasks by conditionally compiling task‑related code and adjusting Kconfig and test configs, thus decoupling the two features.

Adds checks for rxe_get() return in completer, requester, and responder tasklets, returning -EAGAIN when the reference cannot be obtained, to avoid using a QP whose reference count has dropped to zero.
Adds dsa_switch_teardown_tag_protocol that calls tag_ops->disconnect to free tagger-owned storage during switch teardown, fixing a memory leak and avoiding use‑after‑free.

The patch modifies struct io_kiocb, replacing the sole hlist_node with a union that can hold either the original hash_node or two 64‑bit extra fields (extra1, extra2). These fields are intended to store additional return values needed for 32‑bit completion queue entries (CQE32).
The patch updates the XDP redirect self‑test script to generate unique temporary network namespace names using mktemp, replacing hard‑coded names, and adjusts all related commands accordingly.

The patch removes a global modules‑per‑list calculation and instead accumulates the module list size inside the container loop, then aligns the total. This simplifies the size computation and eliminates the now‑unused variable.
Adds a pre‑change‑upper sanity check for DSA master devices, rejecting unknown upper interfaces (except DSA slaves and bridges) with an error, to enforce correct LAG configuration.
Adds qca8k_bulk_read/write helpers and updates FDB handling to use them, reducing register accesses and using management Ethernet path when available.

Adds synchronization and a workqueue to query and probe active Subfunctions (SFs) during driver initialization, fixing a scenario where SFs on different functions were not recreated after driver reload.

The patch removes the custom qed_set_coherency_mask function and replaces its logic with a single call to dma_set_mask_and_coherent, cleaning up dead code and adjusting error handling in qed_init_pci.

The patch adds a Kconfig option and Makefile entries to enable building the AMD RPL platform ACP6x audio driver, creating a new rpl/ directory with its own Makefile, thus allowing the driver to be compiled when the config option is selected.
Updates the arm64 strcmp assembly implementation by importing the latest upstream version, adding MTE compatibility and related code adjustments.
The commit replaces module‑parameter based VMID registration with logic that derives VMID settings from FLOGI_ACC fabric parameters, adding a new flag and updating several code paths to use it.
Adds dedicated handlers for RAS poison creation and separates UMC handling, updating the main interrupt handler to dispatch to these new functions, preparing for future poison consumption support.

The commit updates the maintainer list in the rockchip,rk3399-cru.yaml devicetree binding, replacing the former maintainer with the current Rockchip clock maintainer, without altering any functional code.

The patch modifies ext4_mark_iloc_dirty to skip inode_inc_iversion for inodes flagged EXT4_EA_INODE_FL, because those inodes repurpose i_version for reference counting, fixing test failure ext4/026 when iversion is enabled.

The commit introduces support for PSCI version 1.1 in KVM on arm64, adding a macro, updating the latest version constant, and extending the PSCI handling code to return the new version and accept it as default.
Replaces all strlcpy calls with strscpy in several misc drivers where the return value was unused, following kernel advice to prefer strscpy.
The commit replaces the old qcom,msm8960-pinctrl.txt binding documentation with a new DT schema YAML file, updating format and structure while preserving the same information.
Fixes a memory leak in ntfs_fill_super error path by freeing mount options.
The patch removes a redundant SMU message (EnableGfxImu) that was sent on every power‑up, keeping only the necessary unload message when disabling and not in s0ix.
Adds a macro to generate DAMON module parameters for statistics, consolidating repetitive module_param definitions into a reusable construct.
The commit corrects the CC_HAS_ASM_GOTO_TIED_OUTPUT Kconfig test by removing an embedded newline that caused syntax errors when /bin/sh is dash, ensuring the test runs correctly.
The patch removes mt8195-specific MOD0 and SOF0 macros and reuses mt8183 definitions for the mt8195 mutex driver, simplifying the code.
Adds a guard in __prepare_send_request to stop retrying Ceph MDS requests after they exceed the 8‑bit retry counter limit, returning -EMULTIHOP to avoid overflow.
Renames several io_uring request handler functions to a consistent naming scheme (…_prep for preparation, … for issue) and updates all call sites, improving readability and maintainability.

The patch adds a null‑check for the DLM connection before disconnecting and debugging in ocfs2_dlm_shutdown, preventing a kernel crash that occurs when shutdown is called after a mount failure without an initialized DLM resource.

The commit relocates the entire 'calcs' sub‑directory, which contains FPU‑related code, from its original location under drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/dc/calcs into the DML directory (drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/dc/dml/calcs). It updates Makefiles, deletes the old calcs Makefile, and adjusts build variables accordingly, without changing any function implementations.

The patch resets attr_b to NULL after a possible layout change, then re‑looks up the attribute if missing, and adds error handling that marks the filesystem dirty and makes the inode bad. This addresses a crash in attr_punch_hole when handling highly fragmented attributes.

The patch introduces free_leaf_list() to free inode element lists attached to ulist nodes before freeing the ulist, replacing ulist_free() in resolve_indirect_refs() and thus eliminating a memory‑leak that occurred on error paths.
The commit fixes a duplicated phrase in a comment of spte.h, changing “be split be split” to “be split”, correcting a typo without altering code behavior.
Adds a create_pidcomm helper to encapsulate repeated allocation and linking of per_pidcomm structures in perf timechart, replacing duplicated code with a single function.

The patch updates read_reply() in the RXE driver to correctly retrieve the memory region (mr) when processing a READ reply during a replay. It adds a conditional that, for replay cases, rechecks the MR via rxe_recheck_mr() and returns an error if absent, fixing a rare zero‑mr bug that caused rping benchmark failures.

The patch clears the regulator init_data for the vsys regulator, because the platform data's regulator_init_data is meant only for the vbus regulator. By setting cfg.init_data = NULL before registering the vsys regulator, the driver avoids duplicate consumer supply names, fixing probe failures.

The patch corrects migrate_pages() handling of THP migration failures returning -ENOSYS by moving the failed page to the ret_pages list, preventing double counting, and aligns error handling with hugetlbfs migration for clearer, consistent behavior.
The patch wraps intel_pxp_fini_hw with a runtime‑pm wakeref during PXP unbind, ensuring the RPM wakelock is held while accessing hardware and eliminating a warning.
The commit swaps the numeric values of PSP_BL__LOAD_DBGDRV and PSP_BL__LOAD_INTFDRV in the psp_bootloader_cmd enum to align with the definitions used in the trusted OS, correcting a mismatch.
Changes UAPI IP/IPv6 headers to use __struct_group and updates copy helpers to copy from the grouped address field, eliminating fortify-string warnings about potential read overflow.
The patch introduces a transmit_in_progress_aborted flag and adjusts transmit handling so that a cancelled transmission is marked aborted and not retried, preventing data corruption on the CEC bus.
Adds Justin Chen as a maintainer for Broadcom USB drivers in the MAINTAINERS file, updating ownership information.

The commit extracts all timeout‑related structures and functions from io_uring.c into new timeout.c and timeout.h files, updates the Makefile and headers, and removes the duplicated code, improving modularity and maintainability.
Renames struct udl_drm_connector to udl_connector, adds a to_udl_connector macro, updates code and includes accordingly; no functional changes.
The patch deletes an unused extern declaration of __arch_set_user_pkey_access from the x86 pkeys header, eliminating dead code.
Removes the unused reg_from_user/reg_to_user helpers in arm64 KVM and replaces them with direct get_user/put_user calls, simplifying the code and eliminating unnecessary abstraction.
The commit updates the DSA documentation file, correcting typos, grammar, and punctuation, and making phrasing clearer without altering any code or functionality.
The commit updates Documentation/process/changes.rst, replacing the specific '4.x kernels' reference with 'current kernel version' to keep the document accurate for future kernel releases.
The patch removes unnecessary mutex lock/unlock in the rockchip USB2 PHY bvalid IRQ handler, noting that clearing the IRQ is atomic, thus simplifying the handler.

Adds comprehensive error checks in tcp_bpf_recvmsg_parser to mirror TCP stack behavior, returning correct error codes for socket errors, shutdown, closed state, timeout and signals, fixing mismatched return values that confused applications.
The patch adds a missing ida_free call in the probe error path and replaces deprecated ida_simple_get/remove with ida_alloc/free, fixing a resource‑leak bug.

The patch reverts the recent logic that populated the DCN315 clock table using DCFCLK values, which caused underflow when those states were disabled. It adds a helper to map voltage to clocks and adjusts loops and asserts.
Adds a debugfs file to control reset levels, introduces a mask field in amdgpu_device, and gates reset paths based on this mask, enabling/disabling soft‑recovery and mode2 resets for debugging.

The patch updates vgic_mmio_read_pending to correctly report pending state for level‑mapped hardware interrupts by reading the physical line level, fixing cases where the virtual distributor reports the interrupt as not pending.

The patch replaces direct bitwise masking of PLANE_WM_BLOCKS_MASK with REG_FIELD_PREP/GET macros in skl_write_wm_level and skl_wm_level_from_reg_val, ensuring correct field width handling and consistent register access.
The commit deletes an unused forward declaration of struct seq_file from include/linux/pwm.h, cleaning up dead code after a prior change rendered it unnecessary.

The patch refactors ipa_table_init_add() to take only filter and ipv6 flags, derives opcode and memory regions internally via ipa_table_mem(), and updates all call sites accordingly, removing unused parameters and assumptions.

The patch extracts all devlink‑related functions and definitions from net/dsa/dsa.c and dsa2.c, places them into new files devlink.c and devlink.h, adds devlink.o to the build, and removes the duplicated code, improving modularity and reducing file bloat.
Fixes race in NR_FILE_MAPPED accounting for huge pages by correcting counter initialization and moving __mod_lruvec_page_state calls, preventing spurious increases in /proc/meminfo statistics.
Adds an unsigned issue_flags parameter to cancellation functions and propagates the locking state (locked/unlocked) through poll cancellation paths, updating all relevant call sites.
Adds the compatible string for Renesas RZ/V2L (r9a07g054-mali) to the Mali Bifrost device‑tree binding documentation and updates the enum list accordingly.

Adds architecture‑aware macros to compute mmap limits and updates hugetlbfs unmapped‑area logic to respect high userspace addresses, fixing a regression where hugetlbfs could return addresses above the allowed range.

The patch updates perf's iostat printing code to pass a struct outstate pointer through various functions, changing signatures and typedefs, and adjusts call sites accordingly, eliminating local struct copies.

The commit adds missing le32_to_cpu() conversions and changes the format specifier for atomic_read() results in several driver print functions, correcting the displayed values for out-of-sync and packet-failure events.
Adds an ACPI device ID table for AMD I2C UCSI driver and registers it, enabling enumeration of Cypress CCGX PD controller on AMD platforms, thus providing new hardware support.
Updates the aer‑inject download URL in Kconfig and source comment to point to the current repository, fixing a dead link.

The patch extracts duplicated loops that patch entry fixup instructions into a new helper function do_patch_entry_fixups, and updates callers to use it, reducing code duplication and improving readability.
The commit updates the MMP DMA driver to read the new 'dma-channels' device‑tree property, falling back to the deprecated '#dma-channels' for compatibility, thereby deprecating the old property.

The patch updates the Mediatek clock driver infrastructure to use the newer `of_clk_hw_onecell_get`/`of_clk_add_hw_provider` API instead of the older `of_clk_src_onecell_get`/`of_clk_add_provider`. It replaces `struct clk_onecell_data` with `struct clk_hw_onecell_data` and adjusts all callers accordingly. The change is systematic across many drivers, showing a clear grasp of the new kernel clock provider model.
The patch renames the core struct pcie_port to dw_pcie_rp and updates all references across the DesignWare PCIe driver files for naming consistency.

The patch rewrites the dcn315 clock manager to derive its clock table from DCFCLK instead of FCLK, adds checks for empty PMFW tables, and fills missing clock entries with default values to ensure valid clock settings.
Adds missing @ab parameter documentation to dump_common_audit_data, eliminating kernel-doc warnings.
Fixes a typo in the sc8180x GPIO wakeirq map by changing the entry for GPIO37 from 43 to 44, restoring its ability to generate wake interrupts.
Updates an outdated comment in gsi_trans.c to state that only the scatterlist is allocated, reflecting earlier removal of command info allocation.
Removes the regulator-always-on property for LDO2 in the at91-sama5d27_wlsom1 device tree, preventing the regulator from staying enabled when unused.
The patch lowers the severity of unclaimed MMIO access messages from WARN to debug, removing the warning counter decrement and using drm_dbg instead.

The patch reorganizes vgic attribute handling by moving early calls to vgic_{get,set}_common_attr into the default case of switch statements, consolidates pending‑table handling, and deduplicates vgic_v3 attribute access functions, resulting in cleaner, more maintainable code.

The patch changes the initialization of the variable 'ret' in tve200_modeset_init(): removes the default zero value, declares it uninitialized, and assigns an explicit -EINVAL error before jumping to error handling, eliminating a smatch warning about ambiguous return values.
Adds the PCI device ID 0x468B for Intel ADL‑S graphics to the i915 PCI ID table, enabling the kernel driver to recognize the new hardware.
The patch removes __func__ from dev_dbg messages in intel.c, replacing them with static strings, relying on dyndbg to provide module/function info.
The commit updates self-refresh (SR) timing parameters for DDR5, LPDDR5 and related structures in the DCN3.14 display driver to new values supplied by hardware after fine‑tuning.

The patch changes vfs_setxattr to accept a const void *value, updates overlayfs caller to drop a cast, adjusts cap_convert_nscap usage, and updates the corresponding header, improving const‑correctness.
Updates Thunderbolt driver KUnit test integration to use the new kunit_test_suite() macro, adjusts Kconfig dependencies, and removes manual test init/exit functions, simplifying test registration.

Adds a helper that asserts no ordered extents exist in a file range and calls it in fallocate, hole punching, zeroing and reflink paths, ensuring the expected clean state after locking. Helper is compiled only when CONFIG_BTRFS_ASSERT is enabled.

The patch replaces kthread_stop() usage in several i915 selftests with kthread_worker/kthread_work APIs, adding explicit stop flags and result handling to avoid signal‑pending assertions introduced by recent kernel changes. It updates thread creation, synchronization, and error propagation across multiple test files.

Adds command‑line options –G/--tx-dmac and –H/--tx-smac to the xdpsock sample, introduces variables to hold MAC addresses, parses them, and uses them when constructing Ethernet headers for TX‑only packets.
The patch changes the printf‑style format string in xgbe‑drv.c from "%#06hx" to "%#06x" to match the promoted int type of the argument, eliminating a clang -Wformat warning.
The patch casts the upper bound constant to long in the branch‑offset range check, ensuring a signed comparison and preventing false WARN_ON triggers for negative offsets in MIPS jump_label code.

The patch replaces the single global spi_statistics structure protected by a spinlock with per‑CPU statistics using u64_stats_t and u64_stats_sync, allocating them per‑CPU. All accesses are updated via lock‑less per‑CPU helpers, removing spin_lock_irqsave() overhead and improving interrupt handling latency.

Adds writes to CP_INT_CNTL_RING0 and CP_ME1_PIPE0_INT_CNTL registers to enable or disable the GENERIC0_INT bit, allowing RLC to receive interrupts for indirect register access when gfx/compute pipes are active.

The patch deletes the 'reg' field from struct r8a73a4_cpg, introduces a local 'base' pointer for the register block, passes it to r8a73a4_cpg_register_clock, and updates all related calls, limiting the pointer's scope to initialization.

The patch corrects error handling in s10_ops_write_init(): it replaces a NULL check with IS_ERR and returns the proper error code using PTR_ERR, because stratix10_svc_allocate_memory() returns ERR_PTR on failure.
Adds a DPCD read of SUPPORTED_LINK_RATES during link training when link bandwidth is zero, forcing the Parade PS8461E eDP MUX to reload link‑rate data and stop instability after power‑down.
Replaces manual swapping of DMA descriptor pointers in the net2280 USB gadget driver with the generic swap() macro, removing temporary variables and addressing static analysis warnings.

The patch removes the HW_VAR_H2C_FW_P2P_PS_OFFLOAD case from SetHwReg8188EU(), replaces it with direct calls to rtl8188e_set_p2p_ps_offload_cmd() in the P2P power‑save handler, and deletes the corresponding enum entry, simplifying the HAL layer.
Adds a validation check for the block length in ismt_access, returning -EINVAL when the user‑supplied length exceeds I2C_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX, thus avoiding out‑of‑bounds DMA writes.

The commit fixes a block device naming collision in NVMe when multipath and shared namespaces are used by initializing the head->shared flag before allocation, correcting nvme_is_unique_nsid() behavior.

Adds a BPF self‑test exercising __user pointer tags. Introduces new struct definitions and helper functions in bpf_testmod.c, a new BPF program file btf_type_tag_user.c, and extends btf_tag.c to load and run these tests, checking expected load failures.
The commit deletes SAVEKMSG_MAGIC1 and SAVEKMSG_MAGIC2 entries from the magic-number documentation and its translations, as they are not true magic numbers, thereby correcting the docs.

The patch changes tfp410_fini() to return void instead of int, updates its callers to ignore the previous return value and explicitly return 0, and adds comments. This aligns the driver’s cleanup functions with the kernel’s convention that remove callbacks return void.
Adds a null‑pointer check for sta_rates in mt7615_sta_rate_tbl_update to avoid dereferencing a NULL rates array, fixing a crash when rate allocation fails.
Adds a new devicetree binding YAML file describing the LoongArch CPU interrupt controller, providing documentation for 14 IRQs.

The patch updates batman‑adv’s hard‑interface handling to correctly treat iflink values when interfaces reside in different network namespaces, adding checks for iflink == 0 and for same‑netns self‑links, preventing incorrect recursion.

The patch adds an INV flag for MFSEL bits, updates pin configuration for scs3 and kbcc pins, and modifies the update function to invert the value when the flag is set, correcting the inverted logic handling.
The patch corrects a compile‑time BUILD_BUG_ON check in the kTLS TX driver, replacing an incorrect constant with TLS_DRIVER_STATE_SIZE_TX to properly validate the private TX TLS context size.
The patch adds a const qualifier to the path argument of do_sys_name_to_handle, changing its signature to const struct path *path, improving type safety without altering behavior.
The patch replaces manual dev_err handling with dev_err_probe in the PHY probe function, simplifying error reporting and handling of -EPROBE_DEFER without altering functionality.
The commit deletes the duplicated word 'we' from a comment in bcache.h, correcting a typo without altering any code behavior.
Adds a new GETVXATTR operation to the Ceph client, enabling direct MDS queries for virtual xattrs, with request creation, reply parsing, API function, and integration into the existing getxattr flow.
The commit deletes the unused irq_prepare_beacon_tasklet field from struct recv_priv in the r8188eu driver, cleaning up dead code.

Adds support for a separate GPIO to control headphone on Intel SOF ES8336 boards, introducing a new quirk flag, GPIO handling, ACPI mappings, and driver changes for independent speaker and headphone switching.
Adds a driver for the Qualcomm SM6125 display clock controller, exposing its clocks to the kernel, and updates Kconfig and Makefile to build it.
Adds a runtime warning when an ACPI control method sleeps longer than 10 ms, encouraging firmware developers to replace long sleeps with polling or other techniques to avoid boot‑time delays.
The patch changes an error log to a warning and updates the message to clarify that the parent device lookup failure is benign for macvtap, improving user feedback.
Adds a null‑pointer guard for the SMU context in amdgpu_smu_stb_debug_fs_init, preventing dereference when the SMU block is disabled, thus fixing a crash.
Adds a call to nvme_start_admin_queue(&ctrl->ctrl) when start_queues is true in __nvme_fc_abort_outstanding_ios, ensuring the admin queue restarts after aborting I/O and preventing controller hangs.

Adds SO_RCVMARK socket option to expose SO_MARK via recvmsg, defines the constant for all architectures, introduces SOCK_RCVMARK flag, renames sock_recv_ts_and_drops to sock_recv_cmsgs, updates all call sites, and implements ancillary data handling for the new option.
Removes duplicated word 'new' from a comment in rtllib_softmac.c, cleaning up documentation without altering code behavior.
The commit deletes the OMAP debug‑leds driver: removes its Kconfig option, Makefile entry, and the source file, because the driver has been unselectable for years.
The commit adjusts underline lengths in Documentation/security/SCTP.rst to eliminate reStructuredText warnings during 'make htmldocs', changing two lines of markup.
The commit adds the static qualifier to the cavium_erratum_23154_cpus array, silencing sparse warnings about an undeclared symbol by limiting its linkage to the file.
Stops setting scdc_enabled on Pi0‑3 where SCDC is unsupported, preventing invalid register access and warning.
The commit updates the lis3lv02d I2C driver to use the newer .probe_new() callback, removing the unused i2c_device_id argument from the probe function.

Updates devicetree binding YAML files for MSM display subsystems, removing bogus interrupt flag cells and renaming a node label to accurately reflect that the MDSS interrupt provider supplies a single cell.
The patch restores proper initialization of engine workaround lists on older (Gen2‑3) GPUs that was broken by a prior change, ensuring the code path runs for graphics versions <4.
Removes an outdated comment about locking in btrfs_search_slot() that no longer reflects the current rw‑semaphore locking scheme, cleaning up the source.
Adds definitions for two DPCD bit fields required by eDP 1.5 to support PSR2, updating drm_dp_helper.h with new constants.

The commit removes an unnecessary wrapper for HDP RAS late initialization, updates the call to pass the correct ras_if pointer, and sets the ras_late_init field directly to the generic init function, deleting dead code.
Removes an unnecessary cast from of_device_get_match_data() in the j721e PCI driver and makes the data pointer const, cleaning up the code.
The patch makes tcp_cdg_release idempotent by clearing the gradients pointer after freeing it, preventing a double‑free when the function is called multiple times, as seen with MPTCP.

The patch renames dynamic‑array fields to generic array fields, adds allocation handling for arrays in ctrl_ref, updates related logic and struct definitions, preparing the V4L2 control core to allow drivers to change array sizes.
The commit modifies the DHCOM device tree to use MCO2 as the RMII clock source, reassigns pins, and configures PLL4_P and MCO2 rates, improving SDMMC throughput and reducing EMI.
Adds runtime WARN_ON_ONCE checks in the Qualcomm QMP PCIe PHY driver probe to ensure required configuration fields pwrdn_ctrl and phy_status are set, catching misconfigurations early.
Adds an extra compatible string to the AST2600 EVB A1 device tree, enabling the board to be matched by the generic "aspeed,ast2600-evb" identifier.
Adds a lockdep write‑lock assertion to clear_em_logging() to ensure the extent map tree is locked before merging, preventing misuse.

The patch updates RCU‑tasks trace code to ensure the currently running task is added to the holdout list during a grace‑period by sending an IPI to each CPU, fixing the omission where such tasks were never recorded, which could cause incorrect trace behavior.
Updates BMA400_SCALE_MIN and _MAX macros to correct values matching the sensor's LSB sensitivity and adds detailed comments, fixing incorrect acceleration scaling.
The patch adds a conditional byte‑order conversion when extracting packet data without byte swapping, correcting checksum handling for packets whose length isn’t a multiple of four.
The patch simplifies find_va_links() by removing a redundant range check, relying on the invariant that va_start ≤ va_end, reducing code size and complexity.
Adds a central definition for the 'linux,input-type' property in the input devicetree binding documentation and updates existing bindings to use it, removing duplicated definitions.
The patch changes the return type of sparx5_mact_find from bool to int in both implementation and header, aligning it with the actual error‑code return value. No functional behavior is altered.
The commit corrects a spelling mistake in a comment of the protection_keys self‑test, changing “alllocated” to “allocated”. No code behavior is altered.
Switches rcu_sync_call to use call_rcu_hurry instead of call_rcu, restoring previous behavior that was slowed by power‑saving changes in call_rcu.
The commit adds entries for new Qualcomm PMIC models and SoC IDs to the socinfo driver, extending the static tables that map hardware identifiers to human‑readable names.

The patch replaces the multiline macro vt6655_mac_word_reg_bits_on with an equivalent static function, updates the header prototype, and removes the macro definition, addressing checkpatch limitations.
The patch replaces manual updates of the UART transmit buffer tail and tx count with a call to uart_xmit_advance(), centralizing the Tx queue advancement logic in the OMAP 8250 driver.
