The patch updates the BPF selftest script to correctly return a non‑zero exit code on failure and fixes an unquoted variable test, ensuring proper skip handling and accurate test results.
The patch deletes the obsolete odm_bw enum and updates driver code to use the existing HT_CHANNEL_WIDTH_* values, eliminating redundancy in the r8188eu driver.
Replaces the Python CSV‑output lint checker in perf's test suite with a Bash function, adjusting expected field counts for s390 so the test passes.
Adds explicit include of <linux/gpio/consumer.h> to midas_wm1811 driver so that GPIO consumer functions are declared, preventing implicit‑header reliance and build failures.

The commit re-formats the AD4130 sysfs documentation file, converting a plain list of filter modes into a properly indented bullet list with blank lines, fixing Sphinx warnings about unexpected indentation and block quote formatting.
Adds the RPC‑IF module clock for the SPI Multi I/O Bus Controller on the R‑Car V4H (R8A779G0) and corrects a whitespace alignment in the RPCSRC clock definition.

Adds a helper to reallocate a SCSI device's budget map after the device's queue depth is updated in slave_configure, and invokes it during device allocation and LUN addition to avoid over‑allocating memory.
The patch removes a single register write in gv100_gr_init_shader_exceptions to align the driver with the hardware reference manual, eliminating an unnecessary configuration step.

Adds rseq_len to task_struct, propagates it across fork/execve, updates ptrace and rseq syscalls to handle variable-sized rseq structures, and validates alignment and feature size via ELF auxiliary vectors, enabling an extensible rseq ABI.
The patch replaces pm_runtime_get_sync with pm_runtime_resume_and_get in the sun8i-ss PRNG driver, removing an unnecessary pm_runtime_put_noidle call and simplifying power‑management handling.
Renames the temporary variable wData to reg_value in two MAC macros to satisfy checkpatch naming rules, without changing any functionality.

The patch removes duplicated logic in slave_configure_v3_hw() by calling the shared helper hisi_sas_slave_configure(), deleting manual calls to sas_slave_configure() and queue-depth adjustment, consolidating configuration handling.

The commit renames parameters in the amdgpu_ring_init prototype within amdgpu_ring.h, changing 'ring_size' to 'max_dw' and 'prio' to 'hw_prio', aligning the header with the implementation for consistency and readability.
Ensures the Bluetooth controller's event mask is set before suspend completes, preventing unintended wakeups when wakeup is disabled.

The patch adds limits and overflow‑safe multiplication when allocating OSS PCM buffers, preventing INT_MAX overflow that caused vmalloc warnings; it returns -ENOMEM for too‑large periods, fixing the reported syzbot bug.

Adds support for Quectel EM05‑G modem by defining its product ID (0x0311) and inserting a matching entry in the option driver’s USB device ID table, enabling the driver to bind to the device in both RMNET and MBIM configurations.
Adds a new I2C power‑supply driver for the uPI uG3105 battery monitor, with Kconfig and Makefile entries, and implements probing, polling, capacity calculation, and power‑supply properties.

The patch replaces page‑based hugetlb cgroup helpers with folio‑based equivalents, updates all call sites, and removes an unused function, adapting the hugetlb subsystem to the newer folio abstraction.
The commit raises the hard‑reset timeout from 500 ms to 2000 ms to give firmware and preboot enough time before registers are accessed, preventing premature access errors.
The commit changes the i2c remove callback for the jsa1212 driver to call power_off (which already logs errors) and then return 0, suppressing a duplicate error message from the i2c core.

The patch refactors io_uring fixed‑file handling: helpers now take a ctx instead of a request, introduces __io_fixed_fd_install and io_fixed_fd_remove, updates callers and moves related code to filetable files.

Adds runtime feature configuration support for Xilinx ZynqMP firmware via new IOCTL calls, introducing enums, API functions, and header prototypes to enable setting and getting feature values at runtime.
Adds a new dt-binding property ti,set-io-isolation to the wkup-m3-ipc documentation, describing its purpose, schema, conditional defaults, and examples for AM335x and AM437x platforms.

The patch changes the i915 driver to always allocate the scratch page from system memory (SMEM) instead of local memory (LMEM), removing platform‑specific handling and freeing high‑performance memory.
The patch wraps all do_softirq_own_stack definitions with #ifndef CONFIG_PREEMPT_RT, removing the own‑stack softirq path when PREEMPT_RT is enabled, saving memory and avoiding unexpected usage.
The patch replaces a manual temporary-variable swap in ia64 module unwind-table registration with the generic swap() macro, removing the temporary variable and simplifying the code.

The patch updates jbd2_submit_inode_data to take a journal argument and invoke the journal's j_submit_inode_data_buffers hook, adjusting callers so ext4 fastcommit uses its own writepages instead of the generic path.

The commit updates the devicetree binding for NXP i.MX8MQ VPU, splitting the previous single VPU node into separate G1 and G2 decoder nodes, adds new compatible strings, deprecates the old one, and provides example DT snippets with the new power‑domain control.
Adds kfree(soc_dev_attr) before returning on of_property_read_string failure, eliminating a memory leak in mxs_machine_init().
The patch corrects the OV5640 driver’s frame‑rate handling by using each mode’s max_fps instead of a hard‑coded 60 fps, updating try_frame_interval, enum and set functions accordingly.
Adds Helge Deller as maintainer for the framebuffer layer, updates mailing list, status, and repository URL in the MAINTAINERS file.
The patch re-indents lines and adjusts brace placement in handle_ctrl_vlan() for proper formatting, without altering any logic or behavior.
Adds SCMI v3.1 power‑scale handling, converting power values when the scale is milli‑watts and exposing the scale to the Energy Model, replacing previous boolean flag with an enum.

Adds a blocking notifier chain for VM fork events in the random driver, exposing register/unregister functions and a no‑op fallback when CONFIG_VMGENID is disabled, enabling other components (e.g., WireGuard) to be informed of VM forks.

Removes the extent_write_full_page function and the btrfs_writepage address‑space operation, which were only used by kswapd writeback and never by cgroup writeback, simplifying Btrfs writeback handling.
The patch deletes a mistakenly added comment about an upcoming arbitrary monitoring target feature from include/linux/damon.h, restoring the original comment and eliminating confusion.

The commit replaces manual bit‑field extraction (BMVAL) with FIELD_GET using newly added mask definitions, adding those masks to the header. It changes only the way register bits are read, without altering runtime behavior.

The patch creates a new exported helper qcom_mdt_pas_init that performs PAS initialization, updates the header, and modifies qcom_mdt_load to call this helper, enabling callers to invoke PAS setup directly.
Adds Chinese translation for vm/page_frags.rst and updates the Chinese VM index to include the new page_frags entry, removing it from the TODO list.

The patch changes IPv4 route handling to reject routes whose rtm_tos contains ECN bits, introduces the dscp_t type, validates DSCP values, updates fib structures and lookup code, and adds self‑test coverage.
The patch removes the unused 'task' parameter from arch_prctl functions, updates prototypes and call sites to accept only option and arg2, because these functions always act on the current task.
The patch removes the export of kthread_blkcg and deletes its stub definition when blk-cgroup is not enabled, cleaning up unused code.
Adds regmap_field helper functions for setting, clearing, and testing bits, implements test_bits, and provides inline wrappers and disabled‑API stubs, extending the regmap API.
Adds documentation comments to various device/fwnode property read functions, advising callers to use the dedicated count APIs when passing NULL buffers, thus clarifying intended usage.

The patch adds extensive validation of discovery tables: checks offsets, signatures, IDs, and checksums before dereferencing, and disables the MALL table parsing. It prevents invalid data from being used, improving robustness.
The commit makes several functions static and removes an unused function to silence sparse -Wmissing-prototypes warnings in the AMD display driver, improving code hygiene.
Adds a kfree for fw_control_context when pm8001_chip_fw_flash_update_build fails, eliminating a memory leak in the pm8001 SCSI driver.
Adds a NULL‑pointer check after kzalloc in ip22_check_gio; if allocation fails the function returns early, preventing dereference of a NULL pointer.
The patch removes the unused HMM_BO_SHARE enum value and associated documentation/comments from the HMM buffer object code, simplifying the enum and related logic.
Adds a NULL check before iterating over job->bo and frees the array only when allocated, fixing a crash path when v3d_lookup_bos fails.

The commit replaces the plain‑text devicetree binding for the Mixel MIPI‑DSI PHY with a JSON‑schema (YAML) version, adding properties such as assigned‑clocks and power‑domains to satisfy dtbs_check, and removes the old .txt file.

The patch adds a length check for the IEEE80211_P2P_ATTR_CHANNEL_LIST attribute in wilc1000 cfg80211 parsing, ensuring the attribute is large enough to hold a struct wilc_attr_ch_list and preventing out‑of‑bounds writes.

The patch corrects the port selection logic for VBT packet transmission on dual‑link DSI by using BIT(PORT_*) masks instead of raw enum values, ensuring the bitmask in intel_dsi->ports is interpreted correctly.
The commit replaces a deprecation warning about the userspace thermal governor with an informational message and updates the Kconfig help text to suggest using netlink events instead.

The patch rewrites the DSI 7nm PHY clock registration to use direct clk_hw parent pointers instead of string‑based parent names, removing temporary buffers and name formatting. It switches to *_parent_hw registration functions and updates related variable handling.
The commit removes the deprecated CHECK macro from the xdp_bpf2bpf self‑test and replaces it with the newer ASSERT* macros, updating error handling and cleaning up the test code.

The patch adds handling of color space, transfer function, YCbCr encoding and quantization in the rkisp1 resizer sink pad, sets defaults for YUV and Bayer formats, and propagates these fields to the source pad.
The commit removes the unused IWL_DEVICE_BZ_COMMON macro and inlines its fields directly into IWL_DEVICE_BZ, simplifying macro definitions in the iwlwifi cfg file.
The patch updates torture.sh to allocate 2 GB instead of 1 GB for scftorture and rcuscale when KASAN testing is used, ensuring the required memory for KASAN.
Adds new, bus‑agnostic compatible strings for SSD130x I2C displays and deprecates the old fb‑i2c strings, keeping them for compatibility.
The patch ensures PSP termination always frees allocated buffers and returns the unload error, fixing a memory‑leak when unload fails.
Adds a function to map A619 GPU fuse values to speed bins and integrates it, enabling the driver to apply correct frequency ranges for different A619 SKUs.
Adds configurability for the number of lower BSEC shadow registers by moving the constant into the driver’s configuration structure, enabling support for upcoming STM32MP SoCs.

The commit replaces old non‑type‑safe mapping helpers with new type‑safe from_vfsuid/from_vfsgid helpers in mapped_fsuid() and mapped_fsgid(), improving safety and preparing for removal of the deprecated functions.
The commit changes the definition of the 'range' array inside validate_vp9_seg_params from a stack‑allocated const int to a static const int, reducing stack usage and code size.
The commit cleans up the s390 compat_linux.h header by removing obsolete compat syscall declarations and reformatting code style, comments, and macros for better readability.
The patch deletes the unused, deprecated <linux/of_gpio.h> include from two Mediatek DRM driver files, eliminating unnecessary header inclusion.

Adds support for Sunplus SP7021 Ethernet controller by introducing driver source files, Kconfig entry, Makefile updates, and associated hardware register, descriptor, MAC, MDIO, and PHY handling code.
Adds an exit‑flag check in dvb_demux_open and serializes exit flag updates with a mutex in dvb_dmxdev_release, eliminating a race that caused a leftover refcount and use‑after‑free (CVE‑2022‑41218).
The patch deletes an accidental duplicate definition of tcp_wmem_schedule in net/ipv4/tcp.c, leaving a single correct implementation, thereby resolving a build‑time duplicate symbol error.
Adds a NULL check for the workqueue allocated in nintendo_hid_probe and returns -ENOMEM on failure, preventing a null‑pointer dereference.

Adds an enum for resctrl event IDs, introduces a helper to reset per‑rmid architecture private state, updates structures to use the enum, and calls the reset on first read, enabling proper cleanup of stale counters.
The commit replaces the explicit LIST_HEAD_INIT initialization of a static list_head variable with the LIST_HEAD() macro, simplifying the definition while keeping the same runtime behavior.
